request: Build a small code-lock game in this empty project. Three input actions, `a`, `b` and `c` (keys A, B and C), enter digits of the four-digit code a, c, b, c. A counter named `progress` counts the digits entered correctly so far. A wrong digit sets `progress` back to 0, adds 1 to a counter named `mistakes`, and does not start a new attempt. Once the whole code is in, a counter named `unlocked` becomes 1 and a text named `Message` says `Unlocked`; presses after that change nothing. `progress`, `mistakes` and `unlocked` start at 0.
